# Federal Contract Portal

> The Federal Contract Portal is an APROPOS Group LLC service that helps registered federal contractors find and evaluate government contract opportunities matched to their business capabilities.

## Canonical information

- Official URL: https://rfcp.aproposgroupllc.com/
- Provider: APROPOS Group LLC
- Provider website: https://aproposgroupllc.com/
- Service area: United States
- Audience: Registered federal contractors and small businesses pursuing federal opportunities
- Not a government website or agency.

## What the service does

- Presents federal contract opportunities sourced from official public records
- Matches opportunities to a contractor's business and capability profile
- Provides fit scoring and bid/no-bid decision support
- Supports opportunity review and proposal-development workflows
- Refreshes opportunity intelligence regularly

## Important limitations

The portal provides private-sector business intelligence and decision support. Users must verify deadlines, eligibility, set-aside status, and solicitation requirements with the authoritative issuing agency. APROPOS Group LLC does not guarantee eligibility, proposal success, or contract awards.
